source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The stylesheet gives menu icons 0.5rem end margin and uses calc(24px + 0.5rem) for its selected no-icon/gutter label groups. A separate scoped rule exposes unchecked checkbox/radio icon slots outside the excluded popup classes. Rem follows root sizing, so this source does not establish a universal six-pixel margin or measured alignment. Toolkit rendering and accessibility results were not tested.
title: Windows menu spacing combines icon margin with scoped label padding
